intended_object: The natural inclusion of the semiring of fractional ideals of R (with respect to S) in P into the semiring of R-submodules of P, as a semiring homomorphism. This comes from the docstring and name.
explanation: This bundles the coercion `coeToSubmodule` into a `RingHom`. The proof fields are the existing lemmas that the coercion preserves 0, 1, + and *. These operations are exactly the ones used to define the commutative semiring structure on fractional ideals, so the map is the canonical semiring embedding. The setting is fully general: any commutative ring R, any submonoid S, and any R-algebra P. That is the generality in which fractional ideals are defined. Mathlib has no other declaration of this map.
